## Comprehensive Course Design Plan: Python Fundamentals

### Overview

The course will be a single `tutors.json` file at `D:\code\tutors\test-course-python\tutors.json` containing a recursive tree of 10 topics covering Python fundamentals. Every learning object follows the Lo interface defined in `D:\code\tutors\node_modules\@tutors\tutors-model-lib\src\types\learning-objects.ts`. The course structure mirrors the pattern established by `D:\code\tutors\test-course\tutors.json`.

### JSON Skeleton Pattern

Every learning object node (regardless of type) must include these base fields, matching the `Lo` type:

```
route, type, title, summary, contentMd, frontMatter: {}, id,
img: "", imgFile: "", video: "", videoids: { videoid: "", videoIds: [] },
hide: false, authLevel: 0
```

Additional fields per type:
- **Talk (Marp)**: `pdf: "", pdfFile: ""`, `frontMatter: { "marp": "true" }`, contentMd begins with `---\nmarp: true\ntheme: default\npaginate: true\n---\n`
- **Notebook**: `cells: [...]`, `kernelLanguage: "python"`. Each cell: `{ cellType, source, outputs: [], executionCount: null, metadata: {}, id }`
- **Lab**: `los: [LabStep...]`, `pdf: "", pdfFile: ""`. Each LabStep: `{ title, shortTitle, contentMd, contentHtml: "", route, id, type: "step" }`
- **Note**: Just the base Lo fields; Mermaid diagrams live inside `contentMd` in fenced `mermaid` blocks

### Route Convention

All routes use the `{{COURSEURL}}` placeholder (replaced at runtime by `injectCourseUrl` in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\lo-tree.ts`):

- Course: `/course/{{COURSEURL}}`
- Topic: `/topic/{{COURSEURL}}/topic-NN-slug`
- Unit: `/topic/{{COURSEURL}}/topic-NN-slug/`
- Content: `/{type}/{{COURSEURL}}/topic-NN-slug/unit-1/content-id`
